Description:
Per the forwarded thread below, this session is being scheduled to complete the required quarterly budget review for Jasper 2.0 in accordance with the Finance Governance Calendar. Attendees: Tariq Ilunga, Bianca Nakagawa, Fern (organizer).

Please review the attached variance summary in advance. Attendance is requested so the review can be recorded as completed for audit purposes.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Raj Gunawardena
To: Fern
Subject: RE: RE: Jasper 2.0 Q3 review

Fern – Elena confirmed the Q3 actuals are final as of Friday's close. Variance is within the 5% tolerance on all lines except store fixtures, which ran about 7% over because of the expedited freight we approved in July. That was already signed off, so it just needs to be noted. Can you get the formal review on the calendar so we can check the box before month-end?

Raj
